project.objective: Besides their children John, Hannah Grace, Edwin, William, and James, did Hannah Earnest and Edwin Grice have any other children? Identify each additional child and their birth details.

questions.question: Did Hannah Earnest and Edwin Grice have any children besides John, Hannah Grace, Edwin, William, and James, and if so, who were they and what were their birth details?
questions.rationale: The objective is a completeness/enumeration question requiring exhaustive survey of records that name children of this couple. Census records, vital registrations, church records, and family bibles are the primary sources. The five known children establish a baseline; the research must find whether any births, deaths in infancy, or children who migrated away are unaccounted for.

items.rationale: Collection 2364451 (England, Staffordshire, Church Records, 1538-1944) is the primary indexed source for West Bromwich church baptisms — indexed with images (loc_001). Initial search (log_007) already returned entries for William, James, Hannah, and Lydia Grice as children of father Edwin Grice. Lydia Grice does not appear in the known-children list and is a probable additional child. This item searches exhaustively for ALL baptism entries with father Edwin Grice in West Bromwich parishes (All Saints, Christ Church, Holy Trinity, 1850-1900) to confirm the full set and extract birth details. Search father 'Edwin Grice', mother 'Hannah', place 'West Bromwich'.

The 1911 England and Wales Census uniquely includes columns for total children born alive, children still living, and children who had died — completed by the householder. Hannah Grice's own response directly states the count of children ever born to this marriage, making this the single most direct source for a children-completeness question. Family confirmed in Birmingham by 1891 (log_007); search for Edwin or Hannah Grice household in 1911. A mismatch between the stated count and the known-children list directly confirms additional children.

items.jurisdiction: West Bromwich, Staffordshire / Birmingham, Warwickshire, England
items.rationale: England and Wales censuses for 1861, 1871, 1881, 1891, and 1901 enumerate all household members including children at home. The 1881 census (West Bromwich) is confirmed positive (log_007). Remaining years will identify children born before each census still at home, providing birth-year approximations. The 1871 census is especially important for children born before that year. Search Edwin Grice household in Staffordshire (1861-1881) and Birmingham/Warwickshire (1891-1901).

Civil registration of births in England has been legally required since July 1837, making the GRO birth index (searchable free at FreeBMD, www.freebmd.org.uk) the most complete source for all children regardless of denomination. Search surname 'Grice' in West Bromwich registration district (1850-1891) and Birmingham registration district (1891-1910), to cover both jurisdictions. Also search variant 'Grace' (common indexing error) and mother's maiden name 'Earnest'/'Ernest'. Each entry gives quarter/year, district, and mother's maiden name — confirming maternity. Confirms or denies additional children beyond church baptism records.

Collection 1473014 (England, Births and Christenings, 1538-1975) is a broader aggregate collection drawing from multiple counties including Staffordshire and Warwickshire, and may index entries not captured in collection 2364451. Fallback for pli_001 — search father Edwin Grice and mother Hannah Earnest/Ernest to catch any baptism records not appearing in the primary Staffordshire collection. Also try variant spellings: 'Grace' for Grice, 'Ernest'/'Arnest' for Earnest.

Ancestry's England and Wales Civil Registration Birth Index supplements FreeBMD (pli_004) for the post-1891 period when the family had moved to Birmingham (Warwickshire). Any children born in Birmingham from 1891 onward are registered in the Birmingham district, not West Bromwich. Fallback and cross-check for pli_004; Ancestry may have additional transcription coverage for this period.

A will or administration for Edwin Grice (born c.1854, West Bromwich) may name surviving adult children, providing indirect evidence for the completeness question. Date range is sized to Edwin's plausible lifespan (born 1854; plausibly could die 1900-1930+). The National Probate Calendar is searchable via Ancestry (England and Wales, National Probate Calendar, 1858-1995) and at gov.uk/search-will-probate. A will naming beneficiaries could confirm or expand the known-children list, or show that known children predeceased Edwin. FAN/indirect item: the father's testamentary record is one of the best sources for naming surviving children.

log.notes: Preliminary search to locate Edwin Grice and Hannah (Earnest) Grice jurisdiction. US census search with spouse Hannah returned no high-scoring matches (all below 0.01). Diagnostic confirmed subject has 3 dated/placed facts but no candidate in pool matched.

Preliminary search for Hannah Earnest in US records. No high-scoring matches — diagnostic confirmed subject has 7 dated/placed facts but no candidate in pool scored above 0.01. Jurisdiction remains unknown from this search.
Preliminary search for Edwin Grice and Hannah marriage record in US. No high-scoring matches. Confirms couple is likely not US-based.
Preliminary search for John Grice (known child) with father Edwin and mother Hannah in US records. No high-scoring match; results dominated by unrelated John Grices.
Fulltext search for +Grice +Earnest to locate the couple geographically. Result file too large to read inline. Staged for later review if needed.

NL query using FamilySearch person ID 9DJ7-2BY (Edwin Grice, father). Top results pointed to Durham and Birmingham, England — Durham court records 1901-1908 mentioning Edwin Grice and family. Indicates the couple lived in England, not the US.

Record search for Edwin Grice + spouse Hannah in England. Strong matches confirmed: (1) 1881 England & Wales Census, West Bromwich, Staffordshire — Edwin Grice (b. 1854, West Bromwich) married to Hannah Grice; score 0.94, attached to subject 9DJ7-2BY. (2) 1891 census, Birmingham, Warwickshire — same couple; score 0.82, attached to subject. Staffordshire Church Records (coll. 2364451) show Edwin Grice father entries for: William Grice, James Grice, Lydia Grice (not in known-children list — potential additional child), Hannah Grice. Jurisdiction confirmed: West Bromwich, Staffordshire, England (later Birmingham area).

Collection 2364451 search for children of father Edwin Grice + mother Hannah returned 5 results: Lydia Grice (bap. 8 Aug 1878, West Bromwich) — NOT a known child, potential additional child; Hannah Grice (bap. 5 May 1880, West Bromwich); Edwin Grice (bap. 1882, Darlaston); William Grice (bap. 30 Jul 1884, West Bromwich); James Grice (bap. 27 Oct 1886, West Bromwich). Known child John Grice absent — may lack indexed mother name. Follow-up search without mother filter needed.

Broader search (no mother filter) for father=Edwin Grice, coll. 2364451, returned 8 results. Additional child found: Fanny Grice (born 15 Feb 1889, bap. 6 Mar 1889, West Bromwich) — NOT in known-children list. Also: Edwin Grice born 1872 who married Lilian May Baker at Harborne (father listed as Edwin Grice) — may be a different Edwin Grice family in the same area; needs verification. John Grice still absent from this collection. Two confirmed additional children: Lydia Grice (bap. 1878) and Fanny Grice (bap. 1889).

Search for John Grice in coll. 2364451 returned 799 results — too broad without father filter. Top 20 results contain no West Bromwich baptism for John son of Edwin Grice. Will retry with fatherGivenName=Edwin.

Targeted search for John Grice with fatherGivenName=Edwin in coll. 2364451 returned 669 results — top 20 are all burials of unrelated Grices across Staffordshire, none matching a West Bromwich baptism c.1875-1877 with father Edwin Grice. John Grice not found in this collection with this filter. May need civil registration or broader search.

Broad 1911 census search for surname=Grice + spouseGivenName=Hannah returned 6,089 results. Top 20 do not include Edwin Grice born 1854 from West Bromwich/Birmingham. Needs narrowing with birth year for Edwin.

Targeted 1911 census search for Edwin Grice born 1849-1859 returned 4 results — none match Edwin Grice born 1854 West Bromwich. Top hit is Edwin Grice born 1859 Yorkshire (wrong birthplace). Edwin may have died before 1911; will search for Hannah Grice as widow or head in 1911.

1881 census search for Edwin Grice born 1849-1859 with spouse Hannah returned clear hit at rank 1: Edwin Grice (born 1854, West Bromwich, factory labourer) married to Hannah Grice, West Bromwich, Staffordshire. Score 7.54. Household ARK: ark:/61903/1:2:QLS8-M521. Reading household to enumerate children.

1911 census search for Hannah Grice born in West Bromwich. Did not find Hannah Earnest/Grice (mother) as a principal. Found Hannah Grice (born 1887, West Bromwich) living in Household of James Grice at West Bromwich All Saints — likely the known daughter. Edwin Grice (father) absent from 1911 census; probably deceased. Will search for mother Hannah as widow or head in 1911.
1911 census search for Hannah Grice widowed returned 9 results, none matching Hannah Grice born 1857 Darlaston, Staffordshire (the mother). Will search with birthPlace=Darlaston.

Live read of 1881 census household for Edwin Grice. Household: Edwin Grice (head, born 1854, W. Bromwich), Hannah Grice (wife, born 1857, Darlaston, Staffs), John Grice (child, born 1877, W. Bromwich), Lydia Grice (child, born 1879, W. Bromwich), Hannah Grice (child, born 1880, W. Bromwich). Confirms John Grice (born 1877) as the first child. Mother born in Darlaston, Staffordshire. Critical for pli_002: mother's birthplace is Darlaston not West Bromwich.

Searched 1911 England census for Hannah Grice born Darlaston. 13 results returned; none clearly matching Hannah born 1857 Darlaston (married to Edwin Grice). Possible that Edwin Grice had died by 1911, making Hannah a widow enumerated under a different household. No fertility data obtained from this search.

Searched 1891 England census for Edwin Grice born ~1849-1859, Staffordshire. Top hit: Edwin Grice born ~1853, Staffordshire, labourer in Birmingham, Warwickshire, married to Hannah. Score 7.53. Persona ARK: ark:/61903/1:1:WLS8-YZM. Household ARK: ark:/61903/1:2:1VVC-W76. This is almost certainly our Edwin Grice; will read household to enumerate children present in 1891.

Live read of 1891 census household of Edwin Grice (ark:/61903/1:1:WLS8-YZM), Birmingham, Warwickshire. Household: Edwin Grice (head, b.1853, Staffordshire, labourer), Hannah Grice (wife, b.1855, Staffordshire), John Grice (b.1877, Staffordshire, baker's assistant), Lydia Grice (b.1879, Staffordshire, scholar), Edwin Grice Jr. (b.1883, Staffordshire, scholar), William Grice (b.1885, Staffordshire, scholar), James Grice (b.1887, Staffordshire). Total 5 children in household. ABSENT: Hannah Grace (b.1880) and Fanny (b.1889) — both not enumerated. Fanny (baptised Mar 1889) would have been ~2 years old; absence suggests possible infant death before Apr 1891. Hannah Grace (b.1880) would have been ~11; absence also notable. Record ARK household: ark:/61903/1:2:1VVC-W76. Image ARK: ark:/61903/3:1:3Q9M-CSQQ-T3WW-8.

Searched 1901 England census for Edwin Grice, born 1849-1859. 25 results; none match our Edwin Grice (born ~1853-1854, West Bromwich, labourer). Top hit was Edwin Grice in Sunderland, Durham (estate agent, born 1859). Edwin Grice likely died between 1891 and 1901, explaining his absence from 1901 census.

Searched 1911 England census (coll. 2051997) for Hannah Grice born 1853-1862. Zero results. Birth year range broadened from prior search. Possible causes: Hannah enumerated under a child's household surname, or collection ID issue. Will try without collectionId constraint.

1911 census search for Hannah Grice born 1853-1862. Top hit: Hannah Grice, born 1857, Rowley Regis, Staffordshire, in Household of John Grice (score 5.74, coll. 1921547). John Grice is our known son (b.1877). Hannah listed as Married. Record ark:/61903/1:1:XWWX-NJK; household ark:/61903/1:2:1PMK-DYV. Will read to obtain 1911 fertility columns.

1901 census search for Hannah Grice born 1853-1862. Top hit: Hannah Grice, born 1857, Cradley Heath, Staffordshire, in Household of John Grice, Rowley Regis, Staffordshire (score 5.74, coll. 1888129). Record ark:/61903/1:1:XS75-FJM; household ark:/61903/1:2:1XK9-HW1. Hannah in son John Grice's household, suggesting Edwin Grice (husband) died before 1901. Will read to enumerate household.

Read 1911 census record ark:/61903/1:1:XWWX-NJK — Hannah Grice (b.1857, Rowley Regis) in household of John Grice (b.1858, Quarrybank), Rowley Regis, Staffordshire. This is a DIFFERENT family: John Grice married Hannah ~1880; their children are Tomas (b.1885), John Jr. (b.1888), Samuel (b.1891), Bert (b.1893). Not our Hannah Earnest (born Darlaston) who married Edwin Grice. No fertility data obtainable from this record.

Read 1901 census record ark:/61903/1:1:XS75-FJM — Hannah Grice (b.1857, Cradley Heath) in household of John Grice (b.1858, Quarry Bank), Rowley Regis. Same different family as above. John Grice (gas tube fitter) with 6 children: Benjamin (b.1882), Alice (b.1883), Tom (b.1885), John (b.1888), Samuel (b.1891), Albert (b.1893). Children all born Cradley Heath. Not our research family. Our Hannah Earnest not found in 1901 census yet.

Searched coll. 2364451 for Grice children, father Edwin, born 1889-1902. Only clear match to our family is Fanny Grice (bap. 6 Mar 1889, West Bromwich) already identified. All other 180 results have lower scores (2.41 and below) with father name 'Grice' (no first name) or 'unknown' — from unrelated families. No additional children born after Fanny (1889) found in Staffordshire church records.

Searched England death records for Edwin Grice, born 1849-1859. 278 results, too many to assess without further narrowing. Notable possibilities: Edwin Grice died 1899 in Tamworth, Staffordshire (ark:/61903/1:1:2J5W-MR2, coll. 2285341) — geographically plausible. Several Edwin Grice deaths in Birmingham 1917-1934. None identified conclusively as our Edwin Grice (born ~1853-1854, West Bromwich, labourer). No birth year on most records. Will not read individual death records as not primary focus — noting Tamworth 1899 as the most geographically plausible.

Searched censuses for Hannah Grice born Darlaston 1854-1862. 6 results, all 1891 census. Result #5 (score 5.58): ark:/61903/1:1:WLSD-QPZ, Household of Edwin Grice, Birmingham, Warwickshire, 1891 — our family already identified (log_019/log_020). No 1901 or 1911 hits for Hannah born Darlaston. Hannah Grice not found in 1901 or 1911 censuses via this search.

Searched 1901 census for James Grice born 1885-1890, Staffordshire. Notable hits: (1) ark:/61903/1:1:XSW9-TT6 — James Grice b.1888, West Bromwich, in Household of Benjamin Grice, West Bromwich (score 6.93); (2) ark:/61903/1:1:XSZ7-6PN — James Grice b.1887, West Bromwich, labourer in tube trade, in Household of John Grice, Birmingham (score 6.83). Result #2 likely our James (son of Edwin+Hannah) living in older brother John Grice's household by 1901. Will read this record.

Searched England censuses for Hannah Grice, widowed, born 1854-1862. 18 results across 1891, 1901, 1911, 1921, 1939 — none match our Hannah Earnest (born Darlaston ~1857, married Edwin Grice, West Bromwich/Birmingham). Top result is Hannah Grice b.28 Jul 1857, widowed 1939 in Camberwell, London — wrong location. Our Hannah not found as a widow in any census. Possibly died before 1901, or indexed differently.

Read 1901 census household of John Grice (ark:/61903/1:1:XSZ7-6PD), Birmingham, Warwickshire. Household: John Grice (head, b.1877, West Bromwich, married, labourer), Bertha Grice (wife, b.1879, Birmingham), Edwin Grice (b.1883, Darlaston, Staffordshire, single, paint labourer), William Grice (b.1885, West Bromwich, single, tube labourer), James Grice (b.1887, West Bromwich, single, tube labourer), plus John's children Gertrude (b.1898), John Jr. (b.1899), Albert E. (b.1901). This confirms Edwin Jr., William, James (our known children) living as adults in brother John's household. Birthplaces match church records. Father Edwin Grice Sr. absent — confirms death before 1901. Mother Hannah absent — likely also deceased or not traceable. Lydia Grice (b.1879) absent — may have married by 1901. No previously unknown siblings present. Household ARK: ark:/61903/1:2:1XPD-W6D.

localities.guide_markdown:
# Locality Guide: West Bromwich, Staffordshire, England (1850–1920)

## Jurisdictional Context

West Bromwich was a town and civil parish in **Staffordshire** until 1 April 1974, when the Local Government Act 1972 placed it within the new **West Midlands** metropolitan county (Sandwell Metropolitan Borough). Records generated during 1850–1920 fall entirely within the Staffordshire jurisdiction.

- **Civil Registration District:** West Bromwich (from July 1837, General Register Office)
- **Ecclesiastical jurisdiction:** Diocese of Lichfield, Church of England
- **Archive for pre-1974 records:** Staffordshire Record Office, Stafford

## Parish Churches

| Parish | Registers from | Bishop's Transcripts | Notes |
|--------|---------------|----------------------|-------|
| All Saints, West Bromwich | 1608 | 1676– | Oldest parish; main register series |
| Christ Church, West Bromwich | 1829 | 1829– | Covers part of the town |
| Holy Trinity, West Bromwich | 1841 | None surviving | No BTs — register only |
| St James, Hill Top | — | — | No registers confirmed via FamilySearch Wiki |

## Civil Registration (from July 1837)

England's national civil registration of births, marriages, and deaths began July 1837 under the General Register Office. Indexes are freely searchable at FreeBMD (www.freebmd.org.uk); certificates are ordered from the GRO. FamilySearch holds digitized GRO index collections.

## Digitized Collections on FamilySearch

| Collection | ID | Date Range | Access |
|------------|----|------------|--------|
| England, Staffordshire, Church Records, 1538–1944 | 2364451 | 1538–1944 | Indexed + images |
| England, Births and Christenings, 1538–1975 | 1473014 | 1538–1975 | Indexed + images |
| England Marriages, 1538–1973 | 1473015 | 1538–1973 | Indexed + images |
| England, Deaths and Burials, 1538–1991 | 1473016 | 1538–1991 | Indexed + images |

**Note:** volume_search and external_links_search tools could not resolve West Bromwich, Staffordshire as a standardPlace; additional digitized volumes may exist under England or United Kingdom level searches.

## Census Records

England and Wales censuses covering the 1850–1920 period: 1851, 1861, 1871, 1881, 1891, 1901, 1911, 1921. All available on FamilySearch (indexed, 1881 most complete), Ancestry, and Findmypast.

## External Repositories

**Ancestry:**
- Staffordshire, England, Birth, Marriage and Death Indexes, 1837–2017
- Staffordshire, England, Church of England Births and Baptisms, 1813–1900
- Staffordshire, England, Church of England Marriages and Banns, 1754–1900
- Staffordshire, England, Church of England Deaths and Burials, 1813–1900

**Findmypast:**
- Staffordshire Baptisms
- Staffordshire Marriages and Banns
- Staffordshire Burials
- Staffordshire Parish Registers Browse 1538–1900 (browse-only)

**FreeReg:**
- Heath Lane Cemetery (West Bromwich) burial registers, 1859–1905 (transcribed)

## Coverage Gaps

- FamilySearch Wiki page for West Bromwich, Staffordshire Genealogy was not found (404)
- FamilySearch Wiki England_Vital_Records page was not found (404)
- volume_search returned an error for this place — digitized browse-only volumes may exist under wider jurisdiction searches
- external_links_search returned an error — curated external links could not be retrieved for this specific place

## Cross-Border Note

West Bromwich borders Birmingham (Warwickshire) and Handsworth. Families living near the border generated records in both Staffordshire and Warwickshire/Birmingham jurisdictions. Always search the Birmingham civil registration district and Warwickshire/Birmingham church records alongside Staffordshire sources.
